# Skill packs

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_plugins.py from packs/catalog.toml. Do not edit. -->

Pack IDs are also [other-skill](https://github.com/datamonsterr/other-skill) category IDs. `Installed when` refers to the choices in `sixloom.toml`; the rest go to the bank with `sixloom init --bank`.
Upstream skills are vendored verbatim at a pinned revision (`scripts/vendor_skills.py`) with their license; the only edits are listed in the catalog's `patch` field.

## sixloom core (`core`)

The sixloom looms: spec, design, preview, data model, system design, API docs, test suites, autonomous build, patch and validate.

| Skill | What it does | Installed when | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sixloom` | The entry point for sixloom. | `always` | sixloom · MIT |
| `sxl-loom` | The sixloom loom protocol, shared by every sxl-* skill. | `always` | sixloom · MIT |
| `sxl-specify` | Write or update spec/SPEC.md, the human-confirmed list of features with stable IDs and acceptance criteria. | `always` | sixloom · MIT |
| `sxl-design` | The sixloom UI design loom. | `always` | sixloom · MIT |
| `sxl-preview` | The sixloom preview loom. | `always` | sixloom · MIT |
| `sxl-data-model` | The sixloom data model loom (data-first design). | `always` | sixloom · MIT |
| `sxl-system-design` | The sixloom high-level system design loom. | `always` | sixloom · MIT |
| `sxl-api-docs` | The sixloom API and documentation loom. | `always` | sixloom · MIT |
| `sxl-test-suites` | The sixloom test-suite loom, the first step of the build. | `always` | sixloom · MIT |
| `sxl-build` | The sixloom autonomous build loom. | `always` | sixloom · MIT |
| `sxl-patch` | Turn feedback, a bug report, a spec–preview mismatch, or a wrong locked test into a sixloom change record on the changelog stack (spec/changes/CH-xxxx-*.md). | `always` | sixloom · MIT |
| `sxl-validate` | Final sixloom validation. | `always` | sixloom · MIT |
